claim_boundary: A deterministic integration of already-frozen project-authored mechanisms. Passing the harness demonstrates interface compatibility and preserved invariants, not new scientific evidence, end-to-end external validation, natural-language understanding, empirical semantic likelihoods, human behavior, deployment, authority, action, or execution.

components.interface: finite typed candidate IDs, exact class-balanced weights, exact conditioning, no similarity-based singleton collapse
components.invariant: weights normalize; inconsistent candidates receive zero mass; every candidate remains provisional until a trusted unanimous route

components.interface: belief over state crossed with known codebooks plus OUTSIDE_UNKNOWN; calibrate/inspect/repair/defer actions
components.invariant: common-support sensing, explicit outside regime, normalized posterior, mandatory repair settlement, unfinished sensing terminates by safe defer

components.interface: exact optional-stopping policy over available binary evidence queries and terminal route risk
components.invariant: query only when expected routed-risk reduction exceeds cost; false trusted route and provisional sandbox entry remain forbidden

components.interface: three raw inspections per selected binary query, majority decoding, clean-version-space conditioning
components.invariant: any one flipped raw inspection per triple leaves the decoded query outcome and surviving exact version space unchanged

components.implementation: python/v173_trusted_only_shadow_integration.py plus finite-channel boundary from V190 and decision controller from V202
components.interface: route only a unanimously trusted registered class; otherwise preserve the version space and return OTHER_DEFER
components.invariant: proposal rank cannot remove hypotheses, become posterior mass, or authorize sandbox entry

components.interface: preview-bound local in-memory transaction, exact commit parity, independent verification, rollback, hash-chained provenance
components.invariant: only fixed trusted ontology enters; preview is nonmutating; invalid/stale/tampered commits do not mutate; verification failure restores the complete prior state

components.invariant: disabled by default; full trusted hypothesis set is retained; no confidence-to-likelihood conversion; no authority
